_comment: GOLDEN 4 -- the FASTEST gate in the ladder, and the one that actually runs before every commit. 120 s / 121 epochs, 6 assets, every ground-referenced stage ON: the joint shape+rotation solve, the 3-parameter rotation solve, and the ground carrier ambiguity probe. Its only job is EXECUTION COVERAGE plus BIT-STABILITY -- it touches every line the commit ladder in docs/ground_referenced_orientation_execution_plan.md modifies, and tests/test_golden_fingerprint.m asserts the resulting scalars against a frozen fingerprint. NOTHING IN THIS FILE IS A RESULT AND NO NUMBER FROM IT MAY BE QUOTED. At 120 s the formation turns 0.5 deg, so shape and rotation are not merely poorly separated, they are the SAME parameter to within the noise; the joint solve is expected to return a confidently wrong rotation and the 3-parameter leakage guard is expected to refuse. Both are correct behaviour and both are checked. Scientific claims come from golden_ground_orientation (6 h) only. Shared atmosphere is ON because that is where the programme is heading (run22) and because a per-asset atmosphere makes the carrier probe measure a modelling artefact rather than physics.
